text_block_list.text:
Utter failure... To think this would be my
result...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I devoted every waking second to
training for
today.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I am in good condition, and I even
devised
strategies to contend with my
rivals.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: Because you're not strong enough yet.

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: Because you're not strong enough yet.

text_block_list.text:
They are? Yes, perhaps... After all, there
are
plenty of factors outside my control
that affect a
race.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
As they say, "It all comes down to luck."
There are
times when effort alone
cannot bring forth
victory.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: You've done all you can. You'll get it next time.

text_block_list.text: ...Thank you. I feel slightly better now.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Yes, you are correct... This is certainly a
skill
issue...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: It's okay! Let's train even harder!

text_block_list.text:
Yes... Stressing over this will not lead to
victory.
Only hard work can do that.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Let's review today's race upon our
return... I
refuse to lose next time!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I promise not to let the lesson of this
loss nor the
fruits of my training thus far
go to waste.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
